title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote) - DataForge
text: DataForge is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to work fully remote from anywhere in Germany. You'll design high-throughput APIs with FastAPI and gRPC, operate event-driven services on Kafka, and own our PostgreSQL and Redis data layers on Kubernetes. We're a distributed team across European time zones with strong on-call and SRE practices. Terraform experience is a plus for this role.

title: Platform Engineer (Remote) - DataForge
text: Vielen Dank für dein Interesse an der Position Platform Engineer bei DataForge. title: Backend Engineer (Remote, Germany) - Indeed
text: A distributed systems team is hiring a Backend Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Germany. The role focuses on Go and Python services, Kafka-based messaging, and Kubernetes operations. Compensation is competitive and the team runs a strong on-call rotation with fair pay for after-hours incidents. Apply directly through Indeed or the company's own careers page.

title: Careers - DataForge
text: DataForge is a remote-first company with team members based across Germany and the wider EU. We're hiring across backend engineering, platform, and data teams. All roles support full remote work with optional access to our Berlin co-working space. Browse open positions below and reach out if you have questions about our interview process.

title: How We Run On-Call - DataForge Engineering Blog
text: This post walks through how our engineering team structures on-call rotations, handles incident reviews, and keeps runbooks up to date. We cover our escalation policy, how we rotate primary and secondary responders weekly, and the retrospective process we run after any significant incident. The goal is fewer repeat incidents and less on-call fatigue over time.
